Definition: from G4862 and a derivative of a compound of G719 and G3004 (in its original sense of laying); to render close-jointed together, i.e. organize compactly:--be fitly framed (joined) together.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says the whole building is fitly framed together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord, and the whole body is fitly joined together and compacted by every joint, making increase of itself in love. The church is not a pile of stones but a frame, each part fitted to the next, and the fitting is what makes it grow.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God frames His church together joint by joint, and I hold that my place in the frame matters, because the body grows only as each part does its work.
